title: Metabolism Claims and the ESSENTIALS Line
lessons: The player first notices CELSIUS because the can and brand site make explicit metabolism and exercise-performance claims.
The player already drinks standard CELSIUS and considers the higher-caffeine ESSENTIALS line for harder training days.

text: The player first notices CELSIUS because the can and brand site make explicit metabolism and exercise-performance claims.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Why does an energy drink have studies attached to it?

entry-first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Because I am not only selling you a loud can.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: That sounded defensive already.

entry-first-4.speaker: CELSIUS
text: My brand makes metabolism and exercise-performance claims and points to published exercise studies. You are allowed to read them before you believe me.

choice-first.speaker: CELSIUS
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like that there is at least research behind the pitch.
I want to know what the studies actually measured.
I do not need metabolism marketing in an energy drink.

first-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Good. Read the study, then decide whether the result matters to you.

first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Exactly. A study headline is not the same thing as understanding the study.

first-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then buy energy for energy. You do not have to adopt every claim on the can.
The player already drinks standard CELSIUS and considers the higher-caffeine ESSENTIALS line for harder training days.

entry-return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: You found the louder one.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: I thought that was just packaging.

entry-return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Standard is 200 milligrams of caffeine. ESSENTIALS is 270.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: Seventy more is not a cosmetic difference.

entry-return-5.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Correct. Please do not treat caffeine like a colorway.

choice-return.speaker: CELSIUS
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like being able to choose based on the day.
That is a lot of caffeine for one can.
I do not want my routine escalating to stronger energy drinks.

return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then the choice is doing its job. Use the format that actually fits the day.

return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yes. If that amount is not right for you, do not make it a challenge.

return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then stay with 200 or skip me.

return-3-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: No challenge?

return-3-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Caffeine is not a toughness contest.
